object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Make a git repository with two committed documents, PARENT and CHILD, where CHILD-1's link to PARENT-1 records the commit that last changed PARENT-1 as its acknowledged commit. Change PARENT-1's description and commit, so the link is a suspect link and the repository has no other problem. Run mellon-check. Expected: exactly one check problem, the suspect link; no validation error is reported for it.
